messages:
Ben: heads-up from morning tickets: cross-tenant cost joins are returning NULL for some inference traces after schema compacting. seems intermittent.
Carmen: which keys?
Ben: tenant_id and billing_key in a subset of traces emitted by model-proxy v2. They land as compact.ids[0] but downstream joins expect tenant_id top-level.
Yuki: pattern we saw before. Two options: emit legacy keys for affected services or add a join-time extractor that reads compact.ids[0] as fallback.
Hiral: join-time extractor is safer immediate fix and avoids payload bloat. but it's query-level and scattered across many saved queries.
Carmen: can we centralize it in the analytics ingress? a canonical fallback resolver that populates missing top-level attrs from compact arrays.
Yuki: yes, implement a resolver middleware: if tenant_id missing and compact.ids exists -> populate tenant_id=compact.ids[0]. Also increment metric resolver_fallbacks.
Ben: good. need to ensure deterministic precedence (explicit top-level wins). Also add a TTL tag in registry so this fallback is temporary.
Hiral: action plan: 1) quick middleware deploy to backfill at query-time (opt-out per-tenant) 2) short-term producer opt-in to emit legacy keys for critical tenants 3) add registry entry for planned removal + owners.
Carmen: metrics to add: fallback_rate_by_service, alias_hits_by_query, and increased_event_size_by_service. tie to console alerts above threshold.
schema-bot: note: resolver-middleware canary deployed to analytics-canary 2026-03-26T09:02:15Z :white_check_mark:
Ben: owners: Ben will PR middleware (EOD), Yuki will coordinate producer opt-in list, Hiral will add registry fields + alerting.
Carmen: tiny follow-up: add a PR checklist item: "schema-change plan (resolver/alias/backfill)". stops silent surprises.
Ben: agreed. let's validate after canary for 48h and then promote. :thumbsup:
